description: This file defines the FnDispatcher class responsible for dispatching and executing various functional methods related to JMESPath expressions. It includes method implementations for common functions like abs, avg, contains, sort, and others, primarily used for evaluating or manipulating data structures and values within the JMESPath querying context.

classes.name: FnDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatches to named JMESPath functions utilizing a single callable interface, with internal validation and utility methods to support various data manipulation functions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the FnDispatcher class, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes a function by name with provided arguments, dispatching to the corresponding private method.
